answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 8917 Country: India Title: Please guide whether Muslim males are allowed to wear GOLD or SILVER RINGS??? If yes! Is there is any restriction in number of stones embedded in the ring??someone says that one should not wear a ring having more then 1 stone (nag). Question: Assalamulaikum, Mufti sahab, Please guide whether Muslim males are allowed to wear GOLD or SILVER RINGS??? If yes! Is there is any restriction in number of stones embedded in the ring??someone says that one should not wear a ring having more then 1 stone (nag). Answer ID: 8917 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2257/1757=H/1429) (1) Gold ring is unlawful while silver ring is allowable. (2) It is makrooh to have more than one stone (nag) embedded; therefore it should not be worn. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
